name: Разломный инженер
role: Midgame expedition and technical reconnaissance; a parallel utility branch after riftsteel chemistry, before Magen endgame
current_runtime: D02 implemented in the main Minecraft src and local preview.39-engineer-d02. E12 geometry/UV/atlas unchanged. Production remains alpha.22/preview.38-clock-grip until a new authorized release.

lower_sea_emergency_reduction.requires: four intact pieces with serviceable chemical lining; separate from breathing reserve

tide.stacking: choose one strongest eligible real belt, never multiply or duplicate wear
tide.wear: existing one durability per second of actual active native buoyancy; 240 active seconds at full durability

breathing_loop.name: Контур замкнутого дыхания
breathing_loop.resource_meaning: Stored breathing mixture and CO2 regeneration capacity; not a passive filter that creates air
breathing_loop.lava: Breathing support does not cancel fire or lava damage. Heat protection requires a separate valid source such as Fire Resistance or Magen.
breathing_loop.future_atmosphere_integration: Explicit nonrespirable-medium hook or adapter; never infer support for arbitrary third-party vacuum or gas systems
breathing_loop.no_free_air_from_equipping: Preserve vanilla air budget across equip/unequip; reserve and clean-air recovery must not reset from item swaps
breathing_loop.regenerative_cassette_refill: Recharge existing cassette in camp, return the same cassette and preserve unrelated data; exact replenishment chemistry remains design work

hud: current tide phase and existing timer
breathing reserve, breathing seal and charge
held tool durability and existing mode
explicitly paired or previously discovered route markers
neurointerface.diagnostics: look at supported Interstice machines to see fuel, blocked output and operating state; no promise of all third-party machine integrations
neurointerface.worktool_preview: show the actual planned 3x3 tool footprint before use; share selection rules with the server, never break blocks on the client or promise protection-plugin permissions
neurointerface.night_vision: user-toggleable powered mode; do not overwrite real potion effects

power.camp_recharge_proposal: one depleted cell + one phosphorite paste + two redstone -> same cell fully recharged; preserve unrelated data; no free cell output
power.finite_means: Finite cell capacity and finite harvesting rate, rather than Magen-style unconditional powered state inside the realm

realm_harvesting.realm_predicate: same intended realm family as existing AegisPower.realm; no change to Magen
realm_harvesting.surge_bonus_formula: 2.5 * clamp(native_buoyancy_intensity,0,1) only during eligible exposed SURGE
realm_harvesting.accounting: Server tick accounting in fixed-point units, bounded by cell capacity; no offline or dimension-swap windfall

example_continuous_rates.note: Examples exclude pulses and assume stated conditions stay constant; a whole tide phase is not guaranteed to last long enough for a full recharge

neurointerface.controls: one configurable visor action; pulse from normal press, night-vision toggle in visor settings; check modpack bindings before assigning a default

prerequisites: ceramic substrates and etched circuit boards
progression.upgrade_base: each matching riftsilver armor piece, preserving name, enchantments, damage and unrelated data
progression.research_location: recipe journal unlock follows riftsteel/basic electronics; known recipes remain usable without loot-only templates
progression.ruin_role: optional authored Interstice ruin loot can later supply repair parts, breathing cassettes and worn pieces; not the only source and not a fresh worldgen requirement

interstice:engineer_breathing_cassette.lore: Regenerative breathing chemistry using the fictional materials of Interstice; not a real respirator recipe

enchantments.mending_repairs_physical_armor_only: Breathing mixture/regeneration reserve and battery charge are independent resources; Mending does not refill either
enchantments.native_rift_ward: support explicitly, honoring existing 60 percent native-hazard cap

acceptance_before_gameplay_release: Separate material from temporary iron baseline; exact total defense, toughness, durability and ordinary enchantments
A broken or removed piece revokes full-set sealing immediately
Lower-sea protection is bounded at 60 percent including enchantments; upper sea remains dangerous
Use actual ballast module, actual wear and strongest-only composition; preserve shelter, fluid and movement exemptions
LOS-limited pulse, server cooldown and energy validation, no scanning unloaded chunks or other dimensions
Visor and night vision removal never deletes a legitimate potion effect
Names, damage, enchantments and unrelated data survive upgrades, repair, swaps and reconnect
Recipe ingredient existence, quantities, no dependency cycle and no loot-only critical path
GameTests plus a fresh full client with Distant Horizons; actual Survival tuning remains a separate balance acceptance
Closed breathing works underwater only with valid helmet, chestplate and reserve; helmet visor remains independently usable
Overlapping nonrespirable media consume at most one reserve second per second; clean breathable air consumes none
Battery depletion does not disable mechanical breathing; mechanical reserve indication remains readable
Equip swaps, reconnect, cassette swaps and changing medium never create free air or restore spent reserve
Breathing cancels only supported suffocation/inhalation hazards; lava heat, contact toxin and injected poison remain distinct
Finite-rate realm harvesting uses native phase/intensity and all eligibility exclusions; no charge bonus from standing in lava
Fractional 0.5-unit charging survives save/load exactly; no overflow, negative charge, offline grant or dimension-swap grant
Cassette and cell refills conserve actual items and preserve unrelated metadata; no duplication or free refills

owner_decisions.slow_realm_harvesting: Approved concept, initial numeric tuning below
owner_decisions.closed_circuit_breathing: Owner requested; adopted as the primary mask function
owner_decisions.runtime_implementation: Completed 2026-10-28: 17 final engineer + 62 regression checks, full DH client and separate-JVM region reload passed.
